fix: because of [...] the generals sent out from Carthage to Iberia
reason: Lacuna after διὰ τὸ; the generals' action is lost. Mark with project convention [...], keep surrounding wording.

fix: with courage worthy of his father Barca
reason: ἀξίως τοῦ πατρὸς Βάρκα: worthy of his father Barca. Candidate dropped 'with courage'; keep it.

fix: was no longer even in Italy
reason: μηδ᾽ ἐν Ἰταλίᾳ νομίζειν παρεῖναι: thought he was not even present in Italy; τότε kept as 'no longer'.

fix: [...] they were to call the gods and the ambassadors then present from the other Greek states to witness
reason: Lacuna after δέχεσθαι; 'but if not' is translator's supplement over the gap. Normalized marker to [...].

fix: had come very close to getting Attalus into his hands
reason: παρὰ μικρὸν ἔλθοι τοῦ λαβεῖν: came within a little of capturing (and missed). 'Nearly failed' inverts sense.

fix: showing bad temper both on the former occasion and on this one
reason: κακῶς μὲν πρὸ τοῦ, κακῶς δὲ τότε χρώμενος τῷ θυμῷ: same fault (θυμός) both times; no judgment/temper contrast.

fix: For to the degree that the masses in democracies are more eager in military struggles than the citizens subject to tyrants, to that same degree the mercenaries
reason: ὅσῳ … τοσούτῳ is proportional, not concessive 'although'.

fix: when the entire Achaean mercenary force had given way and the left wing had been broken up
reason: ἐγκεκλικότος intransitive; τοῖς Ἀχαιοῖς = the Achaeans' mercenaries gave way, not mercenaries broke the Achaeans.

fix: he neither fled in panic nor withdrew in despair [...].
reason: Lacuna (***) after ἀπέστη; marker normalized to [...].

fix: he immediately wheeled the front companies of the phalanx to the left and advanced at the double
reason: ἐπ᾽ ἀσπίδα κλίνων = wheeling to the shield (left) side; 'locked shields' misreads it. He led, προῆγε.

fix: Polyaenus the Megalopolitan to gather the remaining Illyrians, armored troops, and mercenaries who had not joined in the flight
reason: Name is Polyaenus (Πολυαίνῳ). διακεκλικότας τὴν φυγήν = had avoided the rout; current sense is right, candidate inverts it.

fix: found himself in a commanding position over the enemy’s wing
reason: ὑπερδέξιος = on higher/commanding ground relative to the enemy wing, as in ch. 16; not 'beyond'.

fix: In just such situations it happens that the commanders most [...].
reason: Greek breaks off at τοὺς ἡγουμένους ***; predicate lost. μέγιστα is 'most/greatest', not 'very often'; invented 'danger' removed.
Μασαννάσαν is accusative; edition spells the name Masinissa elsewhere (Books 14, 15, 21, 31, 36).

fix: he ordered the Iberians to keep their ranks and continue advancing in the same way, [...].
reason: Lacuna after τὴν ἐπαγωγήν marked. Sentence does not break off: τῷ μὲν δεξιῷ … ἐπι|στρέφειν continues in ch. 23, already translated there.

fix: divided them, one part to each wing, behind the battle line
reason: μερίσας ἐφ᾽ ἑκάτερον κέρας ὀπίσω τῶν παρατεταγμένων: divided to each wing behind the line, not between the wings.

fix: and within each wing the infantry the reverse of the cavalry
reason: κατὰ μέρος οἱ πεζοὶ τοῖς ἱππεῦσιν: infantry opposite to cavalry; English dropped 'the reverse'. Minimal repair keeps parallel.

fix: [...] When the tribunes had explained what had been decided
reason: Greek marks an omission (...) between excerpts; English joins them seamlessly. Marker normalized to [...].

fix: when they were marching out [...], after this they should first lay down the baggage
reason: Lacuna after ὅταν ἐκπορευομένοις; 'first movement' smooths it. Mark gap; μετὰ τοῦτο τὸ πρῶτον = after this, first.
